description.text: Objectives This program focuses on comparison on language as well as cultural aspects between Chinese and English including etiquettes, legal systems, ethics, and academic writing skills. The program is designed for professionals who wish to work and succeed in various government agencies, educational institutions, and businesses. Candidates will develop high levels of language proficiency and keen intercultural sensitivity. Duration Duration of the program is 2 years with course works in the first year, followed by a thesis project. Research Areas 1. Cross-cultural Studies 2. English Language Teaching Methodology 3. Sino-western Cross-cultural Communication and Integration 4. Academic Writing Skills and Academic Ethics Credit Units Students need to successfully complete 38 credits including 20 for required courses, 12 for elective courses, and 3 credits for seminars, reports and interim assessment. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship

duration.text: The Comparative Study between Chinese and Western Cultures at Harbin Institute of Technology is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. HITSZ International Student Application Form 2. Highest degree (notarized photocopy) 3. Academic transcripts (notarized photocopy) 4. A study plan (no less than 800 words) 5. Three recommendation letters 6. Photocopy of your Identification Certificate 7. Three passport photos

requirements.text: 1. Aged 18 or above 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health. 3. Hold a Bachelor's degree.
